about.title: Unbiased Political News Tailored to Your Nation
about.subtitle: Voxpolis delivers real-time, independent political coverage and executive fact analysis across global nations with direct civic polling.
about.mission: Our mission is to bring concise, factual news straight to citizens' doorsteps worldwide, with balanced regional perspectives and civic participation without corporate paywalls.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection Standards
privacy.subtitle: Voxpolis adheres to strict global data privacy standards, GDPR, and NDPR protocols.
privacy.content: Voxpolis values your privacy. We collect minimal personal data required for account authentication and localized political news delivery. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Member polling data is aggregated and anonymized for civic sentiment representation.

terms.title: Terms of Service & Reader Conduct
terms.subtitle: Fair use terms for readers, members, and accredited columnists.
terms.content: By accessing Voxpolis, you agree to engage in civilized, constructive civic discourse. Columnist submissions must be original, 500+ words, respectful, and adhere to truthfulness and editorial integrity. Hate speech, abusive language, and unauthorized promotional links are strictly prohibited.
